global_identity.color_palette: the colors of the product's packaging
global_identity.text_typography: a heavy bold sans for the headline in ALL CAPS, a clean sans for the rest

visual_prompt:
PRODUCT: VITALDROPS. Its bottle reproduced with total fidelity to the attached photo (label, brand name letter by letter, colors).
LAYOUT (gift / season): the context of the given date (decor of that season), a subtle bow or detail in the palette of the packaging, an aspirational headline; the bottle presented as a gift.
MODEL: a 38 years old woman, pear-shaped, light skin, a short bob, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup. Emotion: Mujer de 24 años en la sala de la casa familiar, con luces de Navidad y la mesa de la novena al fondo, abriendo un regalo que trae su frasco. Ilusión y ganas de cuidarse..
SETTING: a kitchen at home, natural light. POSE AND FRAMING: standing, one hand adjusting her waistband, three-quarter front view, thighs-up framing.
SEASON: Navidad.

text_layers.text: ESTE DICIEMBRE, REGÁLATE TU RITUAL DE CADA MAÑANA
text_layers.text_style: very bold, ALL CAPS, high contrast, the biggest text

text_layers.reference_position: on or next to the bottle
inside or right below the offer

mandatory_visual_elements: the real product from the attached product photo, at least 15% of the image
the woman: a 38 years old woman, pear-shaped, light skin, a short bob, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup
final_generation_exclusions: any text closer than 5% to the edges
medical claims, guarantees or invented numbers
brands or logos other than the product

forbidden_additions: prices other than the given offer

language_rule: All visible text in Colombian Spanish, simple, perfectly spelled.
